scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run server:dev" "npm run dev"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug --console=plain && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk', '../MillMate.apk')" && echo APK generated at MillMate.apk
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease --console=plain
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
